note: One row per stored assign and operand state measured live (openspec ide-model-mapping 2.1), CODESYS 3.5.21.40 64-bit, English. Each state is one PROGRAM: the editor's own commands drew it (InsertAssign, InsertContact, InsertBox; Edge Detection, Negation, Set/Reset on the focused cell, each command's Enabled read first, `log`), and a state no command makes was then set through the object model (`muts`). `stored` is every network's trees as stored; `measured`: the build with every state's PROGRAM called, a 60-scan simulation run from a driver with `a` high 2 scans of 4 (`v=n/m`: scans v was TRUE, of them with `a` high; an INT `k` counts scans it was not 0, with its last value), the structured code the compiler is handed, the editor's picture (cell tree with each cell's marks, hashed) and the marks it draws. `live`: saved, closed, reopened and the same. `pull` is what Volt shows; regenerate with VOLT_WRITE_ASSIGN_STATES=1 dotnet test test/Volt.Ide.Codesys.Tests --filter CodesysAssignStatesTests. `faults`: states the IDE did not store.
